title: EXPOSED: The $6.6K AI Cost Killer
description:
What if two AI models could replace your $6,600/year software subscription? That's exactly what happens when you pair Claude Opus 5 as your planner with GPT as your executor. Together, they automate tasks single-model systems struggle with—proving that cost-effective AI automation isn't about picking one model, it's orchestrating the right multi-model workflow.

This clip reveals how complementary AI models unlock exponential gains in productivity. The full discussion dives deeper into multi-model AI workflows as the 2026 competitive advantage—showing why the Opus + GPT split-role approach beats expensive software subscriptions every time.

Follow for daily AI tips!
